name: domineering
description: Domineering (Stop-Gate / Crosscram) in the browser against a perfect player, with every legal move marked as winning or losing, and the outcome of every m×n board up to 52 cells recomputed against Bullock's chart. TypeScript, no runtime deps.

scripts.table: node tools/run-jobs.mts runs/jobs-table.txt runs/table.jsonl 8 && node tools/build-table.mts
